amendments.original_claim: 'Timeout attribution: candidate latency property, NOT environmental' + dominant failure REQUEST_TIMEOUT classified at the run level
amendments.amended_interpretation: Mechanism refined: the 120s budget applies PER HTTP ATTEMPT (pydantic-ai model_settings['timeout']); the openai SDK internally retries APITimeoutError with DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES=2 so one logical request costs 3x120s+backoff (measured gap 362s in 5/5 timeout runs). LLM_MAX_RETRIES=3 is dead config on the agent path; pydantic-ai does not retry transport errors; the production run-level wait_for budget is not armed (generation_params carries no timeout_seconds). map_provider_exception misclasses APITimeoutError as AGENT_INTERNAL_FAILURE (it subclasses neither TimeoutError nor carries status_code). Primary classification: PROVIDER_RESPONSE_LATENCY manifesting as PROVIDER_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT with SDK retry amplification.
amendments.verdict_impact: NONE — NOT_QUALIFIED_SCREENING stands; 'candidate latency under frozen budget' attribution survives (same machine/config ran step-3.7-flash with zero timeouts)
